Tags: Adventure, Sci Fi, Family Friendly, Outer Space, Original Work
Description: ‘Don’t give up! You’ve got to have hope!’ is a mantra that the young orphan Ricky cherishes. Soon he and his dog team up with a toy soldier, and together they stumble upon Gulliver, the famous traveler. Now an old man, Gulliver has built a rocket ship intended for one more journey; so together, Ricky, Gulliver and their friends set off for the Star of Hope. While on their journey through space they encounter a nebula that can make people younger and a cupid that can grant wishes, but more importantly they reach a planet filled with people who once lived on the Star of Hope. The robots that they built, it seems, rebelled against them; and to save their lives they abandoned the Star of Hope. As if things aren’t bad enough, these robots soon attack, capturing the Princess of this world. Can Ricky, Gulliver and the rest save her?
